decisions.quote: We could not reproduce the same estimates for Table 3, Panel A column 3. While the original estimated coefficient is stated as 0.0191, we could reproduce it as 0.0263.
decisions.location: Section 1 Introduction, p. 2 (also Section 2 Reproducibility, pp. 2-3)
decisions.reason: Re-running the authors' code failed to recover the reported coefficient in Table 3, Panel A, column 3 (yielding 0.0263 instead of 0.0191, and 0.023 when re-estimated without the unstated state fixed effects), which constitutes computational issues even though the qualitative conclusion was unaffected.
